commits.subject: score (SMB-AUDITION-UI-2 slice 1): processor-state checkpoints, exact backward seek without re-rendering from the start
harness (SMB-AUDITION-UI-2 slice 2): bus and master effect editing from the mixer panel

capabilities_done: (1) checkpoints: Processor::save_state / restore_state (engine.rs, default unsupported); exact bit-pattern state for Gain, Unity, Equalizer, Dynamics, LookaheadLimiter (+ true-peak histories) and Reverb; score state.rs StateWriter / StateReader (bounds-checked, LengthMismatch before change). MixGraph saves bus/master stage states and alignment delay lines during forward render every interval (CheckpointPolicy default 1 s, 64 MiB budget; over budget every second checkpoint is dropped and the interval doubles); SeekMode::Exact resumes from the nearest checkpoint at or before the target. Stated seek-time bound: at most interval_frames + max_block_frames frames rendered after a resume (CheckpointStats.seek_bound_frames, last_seek_frames); before the first checkpoint, or forward into unplayed audio, the distance itself. A stage without support turns checkpoints off (exact re-render from 0). Automation lanes are re-applied after restore (lane-derived parameters are pure functions of the lane value).

(2) mixer effect editing: MixerEdit AddEffect / RemoveEffect / MoveEffect / EffectEnabled / EffectParam on a submix bus or the master, each one routing-entry undo step, refused before storing when the instance does not build; panel rows (enable, up, down, remove, a drag value per parameter) and an add combo (gain, equalizer, dynamics, lookahead_limiter) per bus and master; mixer_json effects

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-score --test audition_session --test session --test session_latency --test chain_mix --test dynamics --test reverb --test eq_response (26/26; score unchanged upstream at rebase); -p hsk-studio-harness --features media,audio-batch,audio-device --test audio_mixer --test audio_session --test audio_batch --test audio_import --test viewer_audio --test viewer_layers (18/18 after rebase); -p hsk-studio-pulse --test bus_mix --test playback_audio --test playback_mix_stream (5/5 after rebase); clippy score lib+tests and harness lib + audio_mixer: no findings in lane files
cases: score audition_session: checkpointed_backward_seeks_are_exact_and_bounded (4 s RT60 reverb bus + automated EQ / compressor / limiter bus + latent master: backward seeks to 2.6 s, 0.3 s, 4.75 s bit-equal to continuous play, rendered frames <= 49000 bound; thinning under a tight budget; fallback with an unsupported stage; state round trip and refusal)
